responsibility: Declares the public interface and key format constants for GCC’s CodeView generator, the DWARF-adjacent debug backend used from `dwarf2out.cc` when CodeView output is enabled. The header defines CodeView built-in type IDs, pointer/modifier/access/method attribute constants needed by the emitter, and the hook entry points that the generic DWARF pipeline calls to report source lines, source-file boundaries, text-section switches, block boundaries, epilogue ends, abstract inline functions, and final/early completion so `dwarf2codeview.cc` can build and emit CodeView records.
same_name_distinction: Provides the declaration side of the CodeView backend: shared CodeView type/attribute macros and the hook prototypes that `dwarf2out.cc` calls. Unlike `gcc/dwarf2codeview.cc`, this `.h` file does not generate or emit records itself; it exposes the interface and constants used to reach that implementation.
